channel.title: Side Projects on
channel.description: Recent content in Side Projects on

item.title: Agentic AI Orchestration Layer
item.description: Task-routing harness and dispatch layer for multi-agent software engineering. Implements agent-selection logic, context propagation, and coherence gates that coordinate autonomous coding agents across planning, execution, and verification phases.

item.title: Algorithmic Investment Platform & ArXiv Research Integration
item.description: Algorithmic trading research platform bridging ArXiv literature discovery with quantitative strategy backtesting. Paper-to-strategy pipeline: academic ML/finance research through to production implementation on live market data.

item.title: Generative AI Studio: ComfyUI & Open-WebUI Orchestration
item.description: Self-hosted generative AI platform integrating ComfyUI node-based workflows with Open-WebUI’s unified LLM interface. Active SOTA experimentation across diffusion models, multimodal pipelines, and GPU inference.

item.title: Soft Policy Optimization: Reasoning Model Training
item.description: Complete pipeline for generating synthetic reasoning datasets and training Qwen3.5-0.6B models with soft policy optimization. Three-phase workflow: synthetic dataset generation (LLM-powered triplet extraction), QLoRA fine-tuning, and SPO confidence calibration. Demonstrates production infrastructure for efficient reasoning models.

item.title: Music Embedding & Clustering System
item.description: UMAP-based music discovery system clustering 751 songs via audio embeddings and metadata. Hierarchical micro/meso/macro clustering with interactive 3D visualization. Genre, artist, and band-size filtering. Real-time similarity-based music recommendations and exploration.

item.title: Algorithmic Investment Research: Markowitz, Factor Models & Business Cycles
item.description: Systematic quantitative investment research combining Modern Portfolio Theory (Markowitz optimization), multi-factor models, and macroeconomic cycle analysis. FRED API data integration for regime detection and dynamic portfolio rebalancing. Published research on systematic risk-return optimization.

item.title: Chess AI with Deep Q-Learning & Russian Doll MCTS
item.description: RL-based chess engine using Deep Q-Networks with progressive Monte Carlo Tree Search. Combines value-based learning with tree search for strategic decision-making.

item.title: Self-Hosted Research Tracker: SOTA Backlog on Redmine
item.description: Self-hosted Redmine instance used to systematically track SOTA research backlog: papers to implement, experiments to run, and open questions across ML, retrieval, and agentic systems. Research discipline as infrastructure.

item.title: Relation Extraction & Knowledge Graph Model
item.description: Named Entity Recognition (NER) + Relation Extraction pipeline for semantic knowledge graph construction. Transformer-based entity classification and relationship inference. Directly integrated with RAG systems for structured semantic retrieval. Bridges unstructured text → queryable knowledge.

item.title: Time Series Forecasting: ARIMAX, ETS & Deep Learning
item.description: Multi-method time series forecasting pipeline comparing classical (ARIMAX, Exponential Smoothing) and deep learning approaches (LSTMs, Transformers). Applied to financial data, market indicators, and economic forecasting. Demonstrates both statistical rigor and modern neural approaches.

item.title: Music Production
item.description: Music production using Digital Audio Workstation (FL Studio).

item.title: Labor Optimizer: Min-Max Algorithm for Dwarf Fortress
item.description: 3-year collaborative algorithm development for labor optimization in Dwarf Fortress. Modified min-max transform with statistical measures (means, medians). Implemented in C++ and deployed in Dwarf Therapist tool suite.
